summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six-month periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025. The filing includes statements of profit or loss, financial position, changes in equity, and cash flows, along with forward-looking statements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer.
